one_line: Frontier AI expands with new models, agents enter commerce, cloud platforms integrate, and security measures grow.

themes.title: European Open-Weight Model Launches
themes.text: NVIDIA released a suite of open-weight models for European developers, and Mistral AI previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4 model.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches open Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industries
Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model

themes.title: AI Agents Reach Research and Commerce
themes.text: Distributed AI agents were used to analyze brain‑cell data, Walmart introduced an Agent Gateway for shopper agents, and Mistral partnered with Mozilla to power the Firefox Smart Window browsing assistant.

stories.headline: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps use AI agents to find leads in brain cell data
Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta

themes.title: Cloud Services Deploy Frontier AI
themes.text: OpenAI models and Codex workflows entered Google Cloud Marketplace, OpenAI’s GPT‑6 series became available on Google Cloud, and Google Cloud launched Vera Rubin A5X instances built on NVIDIA GPUs.

stories.headline: OpenAI models and Codex workflows added to Google Cloud Marketplace
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud
Google Cloud and NVIDIA launch general availability of Vera Rubin A5X instances

themes.title: Security Measures for Frontier AI
themes.text: OpenAI published a cyber‑defense blueprint, launched Patch the Planet to coordinate open‑source bug response, and NVIDIA expanded Confidential Computing with Confidential Bare Metal for model builders.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases blueprint to empower cyber defenders with frontier AI
OpenAI launches Patch the Planet to coordinate response to critical open‑source bugs
NVIDIA expands Confidential Computing with Confidential Bare Metal for model builders
